name: ui-tap
prompt: A short soft UI click, a gentle fingertip tap on a plastic button, clean and quiet.

name: pencil-touch
prompt: A pencil tip touching down on paper, one brief light scratch with a soft graphite tick.

name: ink-stroke
prompt: A pencil drawing a single confident line across rough paper, continuous dry graphite scratching.

name: invalid-buzz
prompt: A low dull error thud, two muted knocks on a wooden desk signaling something not allowed.

name: storm-release
prompt: A heavy page flip whoosh followed by a low rolling storm rumble fading out.

name: creature-spawn
prompt: A small soft airy pop with a faint chirp, like a tiny creature appearing on paper.

name: shield-block
prompt: A firm wooden knock with a short solid thud, like a small shield stopping a blow.

name: pebble-bounce
prompt: A small pebble bouncing once on a hard surface, a light quick tap with a soft decay.

name: creature-hit
prompt: A heavy impact thud with a brief crunch, a solid hit landing on a small creature.

name: victory-chime
prompt: A bright ascending chime arpeggio, four gentle bell notes rising happily, resolving warmly.

name: defeat-tone
prompt: A low somber tone slowly descending, two soft sad notes fading into silence.

name: undo-swipe
prompt: A quick paper slide swipe, a sheet being pulled back across a desk.

name: hint-glimmer
prompt: A soft sparkling glimmer, two gentle high shimmer notes suggesting a subtle clue.

name: star-twinkle
prompt: A high delicate twinkle, a tiny bright bell ping shimmering briefly.

name: turn-skip
prompt: A quick airy whoosh, a fast light pass-by like a page being skipped.
